Questions

Which WageGrid metro has the highest Accountants annual median?

Seattle-Tacoma-Bellevue, WA has the highest published OEWS May 2025 annual median for Accountants and Auditors ($99,370). Among metros with a published median: Seattle $99,370, Austin $83,120, Chicago $82,360. WageGrid does not rank suppressed cells or invent a missing wage.

Which WageGrid metro employs the most Accountants?

Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN has the highest published OEWS May 2025 employment for Accountants and Auditors (41,360 wage-and-salary workers). Published employment: Chicago 41,360, Seattle 22,100, Austin 12,480. Self-employed workers are excluded.

Where are Accountants most concentrated relative to the national mix?

Seattle has the highest published location quotient (1.14). Published LQs: Seattle 1.14, Austin 1.03, Chicago 0.98.

What is the hourly median for Accountants in each metro?

OEWS May 2025 hourly medians: Austin $39.96; Chicago $39.60; Seattle $47.78. Blank means BLS withheld the estimate.

Does this comparison include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS covers wage-and-salary workers and excludes the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment estimate.

U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics, May 2025. WageGrid is not affiliated with BLS. Blank cells are BLS suppressions, not estimates.
